{{Top|leg}}
'''Hive-families''' were the familial units of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] society. They were structured like corporations. When adopted by a hive-family, a Neimoidian would acquire their clan name. The [[Nute hive]] was the most influential hive-family on the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidia]].<ref name="Fact File 2014">{{FactFile2014|33|GUN 1-6|Nute Gunray}}</ref>
